name: cpython-bdba8ef
summary: Rewriting parse_qsl()'s bytes handling to plain bytes(qs) broke support for None/falsy qs (raised TypeError instead of returning []) and silently accepted integers/iterables that bytes() coerces (e.g. bytes(5) produces 5 NUL bytes instead of raising).
evidence: The regressions were introduced in gh-74668 (bdba8ef42b15e651dc23374a08143cc2b4c4657d).

name: cpython-47feb1f
summary: Added a NULL check on sqlite3_column_blob() that treats a zero-length BLOB (for which SQLite returns a NULL pointer) as SQL NULL, so sqlite3 incorrectly returns None instead of b'' for empty blob columns.
evidence: Regression introduced in 47feb1feb28631b6647699b7633109aa85340966.

name: redis-610eb26
summary: A fix for CLIENT NO-TOUCH / TOUCH-command handling in lookupKey() started dereferencing server.executing_client without checking it for NULL, so unblocking a client blocked on a key (e.g. after BRPOP) via handleClientsBlockedOnKey() crashes the server with a null-pointer dereference.
evidence: This was introduced in https://github.com/redis/redis/pull/13512

name: rails-532cd49
summary: New singular/plural inflection regexes for words like 'axis'/'testis' were left unanchored (e.g. /(ax|test)is$/i and /(cris|ax|test)(is|es)$/i), so they also match unrelated words merely ending in those letter sequences (like 'taxis'), producing wrong singular/plural forms.
evidence: fixes a regression introduced by 532cd4, and a bogus test in AP the regression uncovered

name: django-6a6bb16
summary: ConnectionRouter.routers (a cached_property) built its router list by mutating and iterating the same list (self._routers.append(router) inside 'for r in self._routers'), so instantiated router objects get appended and then re-processed, growing without bound instead of producing a fixed list of instantiated routers.
evidence: Regression was introduced in 6a6bb168b.

name: go-3636ced
summary: A refactor of unmarshalDecode() to fix extra-data error precedence made every io.EOF unconditionally convert to io.ErrUnexpectedEOF, even on the streaming UnmarshalDecode path where a genuine end-of-stream EOF (not mid-value) should be returned as plain io.EOF.
evidence: This fixes a regression introduced by https://go.dev/cl/689919.

name: core-ed9eb62
match: static content.*(lost|missing)|cached path.*sibling|insertStaticContent.*start.*end|re.?insertion.*missing nodes|only the first node|interior nodes|nodes between (start|the markers)|clones? only
summary: A perf change that reinserts cached static content by cloning already-mounted DOM nodes takes the 'cached' path whenever both start and end markers exist, without checking that the sibling chain between them is still intact; if the static fragment was previously removed node-by-node (e.g. as a component root), interior nodes are lost on re-insertion.
evidence: The regression was introduced in ed9eb62. In the cached code path, we attempt re-insertion by cloning cached nodes. However if the static fragment was removed as component root, it loses the nodes between start and end because each node was removed individually.

name: eslint-f005e24
summary: A 'dead code removal' cleanup in addDeclaredGlobals() dropped the `if (config.env[name])` guard, so globals from an environment are added to the scope even when that env is explicitly set to false in config, contradicting the documented behavior of disabling an env.
evidence: This fixes a regression introduced in f005e2467edda78a6654c4717aa23e99b3289131 (merged as part of 60c51486849c3765ac21fb63e615db2c56b614fd) where globals would get added to environments even when the env was set to `false` in a config file.

name: curl-b1b326e
match: c->running.*never set|cookie engine.*not running|running = true.*inside if\(data\)|cookie_init.*data.*null.*running|running.*(no longer|never|not) (be )?set|(no longer|never|not) set.*running|running.*stays false
summary: A cleanup of Curl_cookie_init() moved `c->running = TRUE` inside the `if(data) { ... }` block, so when the function is called with a NULL Curl_easy (a documented, supported case) the cookie engine's CookieInfo is left permanently marked as not-running.
evidence: This is a regression introduced in b1b326ec500 (shipped in curl 8.1.0)

name: nushell-0a0475e
summary: Streaming support for `reject` applies every cell path to each element of a ListStream, so an integer path meant to drop a row (e.g. `reject 1`) instead removes index 1 inside every element, silently returning wrong data for streamed lists.
evidence: This PR solves the regression introduced by #14622

name: nushell-d271a05
summary: The early-return guard in parse_unit_value() now accepts any token starting with '.', without requiring a digit after it, so bare words like `.foons` that end in a unit suffix are parsed as unit values and raise a parse error instead of being strings.
evidence: Fixes a regression introduced by #17923

name: helix-b029e70
match: symlink_metadata|not ?found|new file|(file|path) (does not|doesn't|may not|might not) exist|nonexistent|non-existent|enoent|missing file
summary: Document save now calls symlink_metadata(&write_path).await? unconditionally, so saving to a path that does not exist yet (a new file) fails with 'No such file or directory' instead of creating it.
evidence: Fixes regression introduced by: https://github.com/helix-editor/helix/pull/15233

name: netty-31c033a
match: sequence\.length|encoded (byte )?(length|size|count)|multi-?byte|more bytes than|char(acter)? count|chars?( |acters )(vs|versus|not|instead of) bytes?|checkindex.*(length|chars)
summary: The new AdaptiveByteBuf.setCharSequence() bounds-checks only sequence.length() characters and then writes straight into rootParent(), so a charset that encodes to more bytes than characters (e.g. UTF-8 non-ASCII) writes past this buffer's capacity and corrupts other ByteBufs sharing the same parent chunk.
evidence: introduced a regression that can lead to data corruption

name: netty-3c06dd6
summary: The trailing-whitespace/control-char check added to splitInitialLine() also runs when decoding responses, so a valid status line with an empty reason-phrase (e.g. "HTTP/1.1 200 ") is rejected with IllegalArgumentException.
evidence: Fixes regression introduced by https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/14180

name: prometheus-4bdaea7
summary: Moving --storage.agent.path into a new agentStoragePath field only updated the agent DB open call; remote storage (whose WAL watcher reads <dir>/wal), the active query tracker and web TSDBDir still use cfg.localStoragePath, so in agent mode they point at data/ instead of the agent's data-agent/ directory and remote write reads the wrong WAL.
evidence: cmd: Fixed storage flag regression introduced in #9660

name: prometheus-61b4080
summary: NewLeveledCompactorWithOptions declares maxBlockChunkSegmentSize, pe and mergeFunc as zero values and only assigns the defaults when the option is unset, so a caller-provided MaxBlockChunkSegmentSize, postings encoder (PE) or MergeFunc is silently dropped (left 0/nil).
evidence: Fix regressions introduced by #13242

name: gitea-9b6e77c
match: dbHost\[0\]|index out of range|out of bounds|empty (db ?)?host.*(panic|crash)|(panic|crash).*empty (db ?)?host|HasPrefix
summary: The refactored getPostgreSQLConnectionString checks the raw dbHost[0] == '/' instead of the parsed host (which falls back to 127.0.0.1), so an empty Postgres HOST setting (meaning 'use the default') panics with an index-out-of-range at startup.
evidence: Regression of #27723

name: node-85a92a3
summary: stringifyPrimitive now returns finite numbers unchanged, but the new hand-written QueryString.escape assumes a string and reads str.length (undefined for a number), so querystring.stringify({a: 1}) produces 'a=' and numeric keys/values are silently lost.
evidence: Fixes a number parsing regression introduced in 85a92a3

name: vite-1f068fc
summary: Skipping the legacy plugin's renderChunk in SSR builds also skips replacing the __VITE_IS_LEGACY__ marker, while the legacy-env plugin still defines import.meta.env.LEGACY as that marker, so SSR bundles referencing it throw ReferenceError: __VITE_IS_LEGACY__ is not defined.
evidence: fix(plugin-legacy): fix regression introduced in #4536 (#4861)

name: symfony-9749cd4
match: trailing (newline|blank line|line ?break|empty line)|horizontal whitespace|\[ ?\\t\]|end.of.document marker.*(not|no longer|isn't|is not) (stripped|removed)|\.\.\..*(followed by|then) (a )?(newline|blank)|\\s\*\+?\$
summary: Hardening Parser::cleanup() against backtracking changed the end-of-document regex from \.\.\.\s*$ to \.\.\.[ \t]*+$, so a document whose '...' marker is followed by a blank line (more than one trailing newline) is no longer stripped and parsing fails on the leftover '...'.
evidence: regex introduced in 9749cd43c5e only accepts horizontal whitespace after `...`

name: symfony-1942d67
summary: doLoad() decides a variable is dotenv-owned (added to loadedRawVars and later $-expanded by resolveLoadedVars) using only !isset($_ENV[$name]); with the default variables_order=GPCS real OS env vars live in $_SERVER only, and populate() then copies them into $_ENV, so an externally provided value like 'abc$def' is treated as a reference and truncated to 'abc'.
evidence: PR #63955 introduced `loadedRawVars` tracking in `doLoad()`.

name: npgsql-f1bf198
summary: The connector now builds its SqlQueryParser in the constructor with UseConformantStrings, which is still false at that point (it is only set later when the server reports standard_conforming_strings), and the parser stores it in a readonly field, so every query is parsed in the legacy non-conforming mode where backslashes in string literals are treated as escapes, mis-parsing queries.
evidence: introduced a bug where we erroneously went into this mode.

name: rack-f043f32
summary: The Ruby version check splits RUBY_VERSION into strings and compares them with integers (major == 1, minor < 9), so the condition is always false and the URI backports are never loaded on Ruby 1.8 / 1.9.1, the very versions the change meant to support.
evidence: Fix a regression caused by f043f32ce99

name: werkzeug-6650f6c
summary: Deduplicating Map.bind_to_environ() strips the default port from server_name (None when not passed, so .endswith raises AttributeError) instead of from wsgi_server_name, and now appends ':SERVER_PORT' even when HTTP_HOST already carries the port. The crash was fixed by a later commit that does not name the culprit; the port bug by the one that does.
evidence: Fix bugs introduced in 6650f6c7ac4776ff1bac50a900bc74a24135e061
